verdict.rationale: Bento ships an official `bentolabs` CLI with installation, command, and resource reference docs. It claims dashboard parity from the terminal, scripts, or CI, browser-based auth login, raw JSON output for piping into `jq` (useful for agents and scripts), self-refreshing commands, and full signals list/update operations. A probe independently confirmed the documented CLI installation page exists. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as documented in agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI: triage issues, read runs, inspect signals, pull analytics.
bentolabs auth login          # opens the browser, saves tokens to the keychain
`raw` | Plain JSON to stdout. Pipe into `jq`, `grep`, or a file.
Run `bentolabs refresh` to pull in newly added commands.
